Brokild VR · mixed reality

Tank Ambush

Small tanks roll into your own room. They hide behind your sofa, peek round the corner of your desk — the front of the hull appears first — and shoot glowing shells at your headset. You have a rocket launcher in your right hand and, once you find heavy rockets, a heavy one in your left. Duck behind something solid and they cannot hit you.

Checking for WebXR…

How it plays

  • Right hand: ordinary rockets. Left hand: the heavy launcher, which only appears once you have picked up heavy rockets. The trigger fires. A rocket's motor burns for a second, then it coasts and drops, and the seeker only nudges it toward a tank — aim well, and aim a little high at long range. (Tick the red rings above to see what it is locking onto.)
  • A direct hit destroys a tank. A rocket that goes off close by shoves it sideways and damages it: it drives slower from then on.
  • Tanks shoot at your headset, but only with a clear line of sight. Walk, lean and duck — or hide behind real furniture.
  • Rockets run out. You start with six. Ammo crates appear on the floor — walk over one or reach down to it. From wave 5 some crates hold heavy rockets with a bigger blast, fired from your left hand. With no rockets left, hold the right trigger for a machine gun: endless, but a tank soaks about nine bullets where one rocket would do.
  • From wave 6 black armoured tanks with red lights join in: larger and much tougher. From wave 10 they are bigger and tougher still.
  • From wave 8 an attack helicopter hunts you from the air: it hovers and strafes at 1–2 m, keeps its nose on your head and fires tracer bursts. From wave 12 a bigger black gunship with rockets joins it. Aim up: the red ring locks onto them too. Shot down, they spin out, throw their rotors and crash. Hiding behind a sofa helps less against something that flies — get under a table or behind something tall.
  • When a shell hits you the view flashes red, goes black and comes back over about two seconds — you cannot be hit again in that time. The health bar is on the back of each launcher. At zero it is game over, with your score. Clearing a wave gives health back.
  • Grip button shows the scanned room mesh (cyan wireframe) so you can see what the tanks treat as walls.

Before you start

HeadsetMeta Quest 3 or Quest 3S, Meta Browser, passthrough on.
Room scanQuest Settings → Environment → Space Setup. Without a scan the game puts a few virtual barriers around you instead.
SpaceClear about 2 × 2 m. You will dodge. Mind your furniture and the Guardian.
PermissionThe browser may ask to access your room geometry — say yes, that is the scan.

Flat preview

On a computer: click the view to capture the mouse (or just hold the button and drag to look), WASD to move, mouse to aim, click to fire a rocket (the hands alternate), hold the button for the machine gun once the rockets are gone, Q or right-click for the heavy left-hand launcher, [ ] for room brightness, C to crouch behind low cover, G for the room mesh. Tanks are small and low — aim down at them.
